trigger: A parallel isolated-worktree launch-readiness audit discovered that the frozen campaign runner and collector do not bind the executed seed to post-freeze public randomness. No model or randomness run occurred.

high.evidence: The runner accepts any numeric MATCHED_SEED and the collector accepts any common nonnegative arm seed. Synthetic complete campaigns with uniform seeds 0 and 999999999999999999999999999999 both passed.
high.affected_gate: Post-freeze public-randomness lineage, blinded prompt generation, arm assignment, and anti-selection validity
high.acceptance_test: Reject caller seed authority; verify and retain one exact candidate/freeze-bound BLS receipt, derive the seed internally, and make the collector independently repeat receipt verification and seed derivation before matching all arms.

critical.evidence: Caller-controlled seed changes prompt preambles and A/B mapping while the exact production collector accepts the result. Candidate 12 has no receipt, and neither retained runtime nor profiles bind the existing verifier.
critical.affected_gate: Matched-performance validity and the public-randomness anti-cheating contract
critical.acceptance_test: Production runner and collector must fail on absent, stale, wrong-candidate, wrong-freeze, bad-signature, changed-randomness, altered-derivation, or uniformly wrong seeds; the exact verified receipt must be retained in campaign evidence.

bounded_fix_scope: direct production-path tests and induced freeze bindings
